name: mas-scholar-skills
description: Repo-tracked framework capability plugin with required refs-only MAS medical-paper and MAG medical-grant capability profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Required MAS paper and MAG grant capability Skills.
interface.longDescription: Provides refs-only MAS medical-paper and MAG medical-grant capability profiles. All exported Skills may be bundled or materialized for native discovery; MAS and MAG still require the Package identity and selected capability set to be present and callable. Missing or incompatible profile Skills fail closed for the affected consumer while preserving the consumer's domain authority.
defaultPrompt: Route this medical research task to the matching Scholar Skill.
Prepare refs-only candidate material for the consuming domain owner.
Review this medical research artifact without claiming domain readiness.
